_about: Default assumptions for the v3.1 calculator. Every value is sourced (see 'source'), a PLACEHOLDER to be replaced, or ILLUSTRATIVE: taken from the CX Capacity Model example, which shows a structure to follow, not a spec to match. 2027 targets come from the project brief and are interpreted, not yet confirmed.

portfolio_share.source: ILLUSTRATIVE. From the CX Capacity Model example (Account Caps, Hours tab), not validated for this team. 70% customer-facing focus.

availability.source: PLACEHOLDER. Holidays, sickness and internal time are not yet modelled. 100% keeps v2 like-for-like. Expect roughly 0.85 to 0.90.

target_pool.source: Project instructions (pool target; reactive queues need more slack)

slg_eur.source: 2027 target from the project brief (Sales Led Growth EUR 5.5m). Interpreted as expansion, mapped to the company base. Confirm with Finance.

plg_eur.source: 2027 target from the project brief (Product Led Growth EUR 12.6m). Interpreted as expansion. Confirm with Finance.

larr_eur.source: 2027 target from the project brief (LARR EUR 18.2m). Interpreted as the lost-ARR budget. FY26 comparator EUR 18m lost ARR (CX offsite). Confirm with Finance.

company_arr_eur.source: CX ARR EUR 87.9m (CX offsite agenda, used for the FY26 churn rate of 20.5%). Company base for company-wide rates.

asp_eur.source: CX Capacity Model WIP tab: ASP USD 12,000 to 12,800. Currency not confirmed; top of range used as a EUR placeholder.
